definition: To cut or grip something with the teeth; to take a small piece using the teeth
example: I took a bite of the apple; the skin was crisp

definition: To grind food with the teeth to make it easier to swallow
example: Chew your food slowly so you can taste it

definition: To move food or drink from the mouth down the throat
example: He swallowed the pill with a sip of water

definition: To drink a small amount slowly from a cup or glass
example: She took a sip of hot tea

definition: To drink or eat with a loud sucking sound
example: He slurped the soup from the spoon

definition: To swallow a large amount quickly
example: She gulped the water after the run
